circle: Equally spaced unit-circle points: angle 2*pi*i/n, i=0,...,n-1.
planar: NumPy default_rng(260106), n by 2 independent uniform(-1,1) coordinates.
sphere: NumPy default_rng(610026), n by 3 independent standard-normal coordinates, each row normalized to unit length.
sparse_sphere: Same spherical construction; store exactly distances <= 1.5.
grades: Euclidean distances rounded using rint(distance*4096)/4096; supplied dissimilarities are shared exactly across Float32 and Float64.
format: Dense: lower triangle in row order, one distance per line. Sparse: 0-based i j distance triples for i>j. 17-significant-digit text.
input_integrity: Exact input SHA256 values are recorded in manifest.json.
